P01.rationale: A person presenting with a microphone occupies roughly the left third of the full-bleed photo and is clearly the visual anchor, though not isolated as a clean portrait.

P05.rationale: No case study section with named client portraits is present anywhere on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block is visible on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used anywhere on the page.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, before/after comparisons, charts, or cost-math graphics are present.

P12.rationale: The page is dominated by a single full-bleed photo with only a short text block at the bottom, leaving it compositionally sparse rather than magazine-dense.

P13.rationale: The full-bleed event photography provides a rich atmospheric background that gives the page a strong environmental texture.

P14.rationale: Text is placed over the darker lower portion of the photo which provides some natural contrast, but no explicit scrim or darkening treatment is applied, making readability marginal.

P16.rationale: No phone, laptop, or product mockup is featured as a deliberate design device on this page.

N07.rationale: The event/presentation setting with branded roll-up banners feels specific to a real business context rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: The right half of the image (projection screen area) is largely empty/white, creating a noticeable dead zone in the composition.

N10.rationale: The bold white text sits directly over the busy lower portion of the photo with no scrim, relying solely on the naturally darker area for contrast, which is inconsistent and risky.
